ValidationRule.description: A person cannot set a lead to MQL when it has no segment or is below the fleet threshold. Cannot stop a form lead: the Lead Flow sets the stage first and never sets MQL on such a lead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Lifecycle_Stage__c, "MQL"), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Segment__c)), ISPICKVAL(Segment__c, "Below Threshold") ), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Lead_Automation) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A lead needs a fleet size of 20 or more to be MQL.
